text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N5","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT :- 1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC. 2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The note specifies hardness but does not state whether heat treatment is to be performed before or after machining, which matters because machining a 24-32 HRC part requires different tooling and process planning than machining soft stock. The designer should add the manufacturing stage at which the toughening applies (e.g., 'after rough machining, before finish grinding').","recommended_correction":"Amend N5 to specify the stage of heat treatment relative to machining operations."},{"rule_id":"NM-008","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N6","page":1,"quote":"NOTE FOR WIPRO PARI DESIGN -REF. ONLY WEAR DETAILS : MW"}],"comment":"This note references another entity's design wear details and appears copied from a different drawing; it has no meaning for manufacturing or inspecting this stop pin and may confuse the shop. The designer should remove N6 entirely.","recommended_correction":"Delete note N6 from the drawing."},{"rule_id":"TL-002","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D8","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 20"}],"comment":"A stop pin's shank diameter is a functional mating feature that locates or stops other components, yet D8 carries no fit or tolerance callout and would default to the general ±0.5 mm, which is far too loose for a locating pin. The designer should add an appropriate fit designation (e.g., h7 or g6) to D8 so the pin functions correctly in its mating hole.","recommended_correction":"Add a fit or tolerance callout to dimension D8 suitable for the pin's locating function."}]}
